requirement_text.REQ-378: See handoffs/WF03-ISS0736-20260921/step-00-git-setup.json context.requirement_text.REQ-378 for the full verbatim text. Acceptance criterion 1 (the one this test must prove): a tenant_admin action that revokes a signed-in business_user's access to a specific area takes effect on that user's very next request, without requiring the user to sign out, reload, or wait for the access token to expire -- demonstrated by a test that revokes and immediately retries with no sleep or token refresh.

task.description: Write a regression test proving REQ-378's fix. This is a fix to EXISTING behavior (authenticate_oidc/2 already existed pre-fix), so WF-03.md's normal fail-then-pass rule applies, not the 'code did not exist' exception: the test must be shown to FAIL against the pre-fix code (main, or this branch with the fix reverted) and PASS against the post-fix code (this branch as-is). Concretely: (1) a test simulating an OIDC-authenticated request where the user holds a role/group membership that grants access to some route, asserting the request succeeds (200/expected data); (2) simulate the tenant_admin revoking that access (remove the group membership / deactivate the user, via the same Identity functions the GUI fix now calls -- Identity.remove_group_member/3 or the equivalent status-update function) WITHOUT re-authenticating, re-minting a JWT, or sleeping; (3) immediately retry the exact same request with the SAME still-valid JWT and assert it now returns 403 (or the account-inactive path's own status), proving the change took effect on the very next request purely from the live DB check, not from any token change. Use ExUnit + whatever test harness this codebase already uses for AuthPipeline/API route tests (grep test/ for existing auth_pipeline or authorization test files for the harness pattern -- do not invent a new one). Prove the fail-then-pass property: run this exact test file against a git worktree of main (pre-fix) or this branch with only lib/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline.ex and lib/letflow/identity.ex reverted (git checkout main -- <paths> in a throwaway worktree), confirm it fails there, then confirm it passes on this branch as-is. State both runs' actual output in result.summary. Also add/extend a test proving AC2's GUI path works (the corrected groupsApi.removeMembers call reaches the real endpoint) -- can be a lighter unit/integration test on the identity.ts function or an existing web/ test pattern; check web/ for its existing test conventions (grep for existing *.test.ts(x) near api/identity.ts or GroupsPage.tsx) rather than inventing one.
acceptance_criteria: Test file(s) added under test/ (backend) and/or web/ test dir (frontend) following existing conventions in this codebase, not a new pattern

Fail-then-pass proof stated with actual quoted output from both runs (pre-fix fail, post-fix pass), using a throwaway worktree for the pre-fix run per WF-03.md's isolation technique -- and the worktree/mutation is cleaned up and verified clean afterward (git status --porcelain empty) per WF-03.md's mutant-cleanup rule
The backend test uses no sleep/token-refresh and re-uses the same JWT/session across the before/after requests
A test also covers AC2's GUI-reachable path
Do NOT implement further product code -- test files only
